---
title: "Viewshed Calculator"
date: 2026-09-07
categories: [tool, raster]
description: "Upload a DEM, place an observer, and see which cells are visible from that point — a colored map overlay and a downloadable GeoTIFF. Runs entirely in your browser, powered by R."
page-layout: full
---

Upload a `.tif`/`.tiff` elevation model (DEM), click the map (or type
coordinates) to place an observer, and see which cells are visible
from that point — accounting for terrain occlusion.

::: {.callout-tip}
**Private by design.** Your file is processed entirely in your
browser (R via WebAssembly) — it's never uploaded to any server,
including ours. Nothing to configure, nothing to trust: the code
never gets the chance to see your data.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
```
```{ojs}
//| output: false
{
  // R-only tool — the first one in this project. rasterio/GDAL have
  // no viewshed function usable in Pyodide (verified directly against
  // this project: gdal isn't in Pyodide's own curated package index),
  // while terra::viewshed() works. Skip writing to Python's
  // filesystem entirely, same reasoning every Python-only tool here
  // already uses in reverse.
  mutable uploadBusy = true;
  mutable uploadStatus = "⌛ Uploading...";
  try {
    const result = await WebGeoDS.Upload.load(uploadedFiles, { languages: ["r"] });
    if (result.ok) {
      mutable uploadStatus = "⌛ Inspecting...";
      await autoInspect();
      mutable uploadStatus = result.message;
    } else {
      mutable uploadStatus = result.message;
    }
  } finally {
    mutable uploadBusy = false;
  }
}
```

computation using `terra::viewshed()` underneath. Want to see it
built up step by step (and read why this tool runs on R, not Python)?
Read
[Viewshed: What's Visible from Here](/posts/raster-viewshed.html).

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// "Load example" writes a small synthetic DEM directly — a Gaussian
// hill, same shape reused across the whole Raster family, but here
// deliberately in a GEOGRAPHIC CRS (EPSG:4326), the case real-world
// DEMs (SRTM and similar) commonly ship in and the one
// terra::viewshed() itself refuses to compute on directly — so the
// example exercises the tool's own automatic reprojection path, not
// just the easy case.
generateExample = async () => {
  await window.WebGeoDS.CodeCell.find("viewshed-generate-example-r").run();
}
```

```{.webgeods-r #viewshed-generate-example-r}
#| package: terra, codetools
library(terra)

n <- 20
xs <- 0:(n - 1)
ys <- 0:(n - 1)
elevation <- outer(ys, xs, function(y, x) 100 + 40 * exp(-((x - 10)^2 + (y - 10)^2) / 30))
r <- rast(elevation, crs = "EPSG:4326")
ext(r) <- c(12.40, 12.40 + n * 0.005, 41.95 - n * 0.005, 41.95)

writeRaster(r, "/uploaded.tif", overwrite = TRUE, filetype = "GTiff")

"example DEM written"
```

```{.webgeods-r #viewshed-inspect-r}
#| package: terra, jsonlite, codetools
library(terra)

path <- NULL
for (candidate in c("/uploaded.tif")) {
  ok <- tryCatch({ rast(candidate); TRUE }, error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (ok) { path <- candidate; break }
}

summary_out <- NULL
footprint <- list(type = jsonlite::unbox("FeatureCollection"), features = list())

if (!is.null(path)) {
  r <- rast(path)
  # Only the first band is treated as elevation -- a DEM is normally
  # single-band; extra bands (if any) are simply ignored, same
  # reasoning as every raster tool on this site that only needs one
  # value per pixel.
  elevation <- r[[1]]

  # Same missing-CRS convention as the rest of the Raster family:
  # unknown stays unknown, never silently relabeled as WGS84. Here the
  # stakes are higher than a display nuance -- viewshed cannot pick a
  # working projection or place an observer without knowing where on
  # Earth the file actually is, so Compute refuses outright on a
  # CRS-less file (see viewshed-r below) rather than guessing.
  crs_label <- if (crs(elevation) == "") {
    NULL
  } else {
    crs_desc <- crs(elevation, describe = TRUE)
    if (!is.na(crs_desc$authority) && !is.na(crs_desc$code)) {
      paste0(crs_desc$authority, ":", crs_desc$code)
    } else {
      crs(elevation, proj = TRUE)
    }
  }

  e <- ext(elevation)
  bbox_wkt <- paste0(
    "POLYGON((",
    e$xmin, " ", e$ymin, ", ", e$xmax, " ", e$ymin, ", ",
    e$xmax, " ", e$ymax, ", ", e$xmin, " ", e$ymax, ", ",
    e$xmin, " ", e$ymin, "))"
  )
  bbox_vect <- vect(bbox_wkt, crs = if (crs(elevation) == "") "EPSG:4326" else crs(elevation))
  bbox_wgs84 <- tryCatch(project(bbox_vect, "EPSG:4326"), error = function(err) bbox_vect)
  bbox_geom <- geom(bbox_wgs84)
  footprint_coords <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(bbox_geom)), function(i) c(bbox_geom[i, "x"], bbox_geom[i, "y"]))

  footprint <- list(
    type = jsonlite::unbox("FeatureCollection"),
    features = list(list(
      type = jsonlite::unbox("Feature"),
      properties = list(name = jsonlite::unbox("DEM footprint")),
      geometry = list(type = jsonlite::unbox("Polygon"), coordinates = list(footprint_coords))
    ))
  )

  summary_out <- list(
    width = jsonlite::unbox(ncol(elevation)),
    height = jsonlite::unbox(nrow(elevation)),
    crs = if (is.null(crs_label)) NULL else jsonlite::unbox(crs_label),
    bounds = round(c(e$xmin, e$ymin, e$xmax, e$ymax), 6)
  )
}

result <- list(summary = summary_out, footprint = footprint)
jsonlite::fromJSON(jsonlite::toJSON(result, null = "null"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
```
```{ojs}
// base64 -> raw bytes, same pattern as the rest of the site (binary
// data can only cross the webR->JS bridge as a cell value via a text
// encoding).
base64ToBytes = (base64Str) => {
  const binary = atob(base64Str);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
  return bytes;
}
```

```{.webgeods-r #viewshed-r}
#| inject: [obsLon, obsLat, obsHeight]
#| package: terra, jsonlite, codetools
library(terra)

r <- rast(path)
elevation <- r[[1]]

if (crs(elevation) == "") {
  stop("This file has no declared CRS — a real-world location is required to compute a viewshed (to choose a working projection and place the observer correctly). Upload a georeferenced DEM.")
}

original_crs_label <- {
  crs_desc <- crs(elevation, describe = TRUE)
  if (!is.na(crs_desc$authority) && !is.na(crs_desc$code)) {
    paste0(crs_desc$authority, ":", crs_desc$code)
  } else {
    crs(elevation, proj = TRUE)
  }
}

# Working/calculation CRS: terra::viewshed() requires projected
# coordinates (confirmed empirically -- it throws "the method does
# not support lon/lat data" otherwise). A geographic DEM is
# reprojected HERE, for this calculation only -- the original raster
# is never modified, and the CRS reported above is the file's real
# one, not this working projection. The UTM zone is picked from the
# raster's own centre -- a reasonable default for a single local DEM,
# not a universally correct choice (a DEM spanning multiple UTM
# zones, near the poles, or very large would need a deliberate choice
# instead).
if (is.lonlat(elevation)) {
  e <- ext(elevation)
  center_lon <- (e$xmin + e$xmax) / 2
  center_lat <- (e$ymin + e$ymax) / 2
  utm_zone <- floor((center_lon + 180) / 6) + 1
  calc_epsg <- if (center_lat >= 0) 32600 + utm_zone else 32700 + utm_zone
  elevation_calc <- project(elevation, paste0("EPSG:", calc_epsg), method = "bilinear")
} else {
  elevation_calc <- elevation
}

calc_crs_label <- {
  crs_desc <- crs(elevation_calc, describe = TRUE)
  if (!is.na(crs_desc$authority) && !is.na(crs_desc$code)) {
    paste0(crs_desc$authority, ":", crs_desc$code)
  } else {
    crs(elevation_calc, proj = TRUE)
  }
}

# The observer point always arrives as lon/lat (map click or manual
# input) and is reprojected into whatever the calculation CRS turned
# out to be -- whether or not the raster itself needed reprojecting.
obs_pt <- vect(matrix(c(as.numeric(obsLon), as.numeric(obsLat)), ncol = 2), crs = "EPSG:4326")
obs_pt_calc <- project(obs_pt, crs(elevation_calc))
obs_xy <- as.numeric(crds(obs_pt_calc)[1, ])

vs <- viewshed(elevation_calc, loc = obs_xy, observer = as.numeric(obsHeight), target = 0)

# Recoded for the shared canvas renderer (shared/map.js): NaN already
# renders transparent there, so "not visible" becomes NaN instead of
# FALSE/0 -- only the visible area paints, nothing new needed in
# shared code, same trick as this tool's own Calculator/NDVI siblings
# reusing setRasterImage() without modifying it.
vs_num <- as.numeric(values(vs, mat = FALSE))
visible_mask <- vs_num == 1
vs_num[!visible_mask] <- NaN
vs_num[visible_mask] <- 1

n_visible <- sum(visible_mask, na.rm = TRUE)
n_total <- length(vs_num)

e_calc <- ext(elevation_calc)
bbox_wkt <- paste0(
  "POLYGON((",
  e_calc$xmin, " ", e_calc$ymin, ", ", e_calc$xmax, " ", e_calc$ymin, ", ",
  e_calc$xmax, " ", e_calc$ymax, ", ", e_calc$xmin, " ", e_calc$ymax, ", ",
  e_calc$xmin, " ", e_calc$ymin, "))"
)
bbox_vect <- vect(bbox_wkt, crs = crs(elevation_calc))
bbox_wgs84 <- tryCatch(project(bbox_vect, "EPSG:4326"), error = function(err) bbox_vect)
bbox_geom <- geom(bbox_wgs84)
footprint_coords <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(bbox_geom)), function(i) c(bbox_geom[i, "x"], bbox_geom[i, "y"]))
e_wgs84 <- ext(bbox_wgs84)

footprint <- list(
  type = jsonlite::unbox("FeatureCollection"),
  features = list(list(
    type = jsonlite::unbox("Feature"),
    properties = list(name = jsonlite::unbox("viewshed footprint")),
    geometry = list(type = jsonlite::unbox("Polygon"), coordinates = list(footprint_coords))
  ))
)

# Same base64-float32 pixel transfer already proven for Band Math/NDVI
# on the R side: rawConnection()+writeBin()+jsonlite::base64_enc().
con <- rawConnection(raw(0), "wb")
writeBin(vs_num, con, size = 4, endian = "little")
raw_bytes <- rawConnectionValue(con)
close(con)
data_b64 <- jsonlite::base64_enc(raw_bytes)

summary_out <- list(
  width = jsonlite::unbox(ncol(vs)),
  height = jsonlite::unbox(nrow(vs)),
  data = jsonlite::unbox(data_b64),
  wgs84Bounds = round(c(e_wgs84$xmin, e_wgs84$ymin, e_wgs84$xmax, e_wgs84$ymax), 6),
  originalCrs = jsonlite::unbox(original_crs_label),
  calculationCrs = jsonlite::unbox(calc_crs_label),
  observerHeight = jsonlite::unbox(as.numeric(obsHeight)),
  visiblePixels = jsonlite::unbox(n_visible),
  totalPixels = jsonlite::unbox(n_total),
  visiblePercent = jsonlite::unbox(round(100 * n_visible / n_total, 1))
)

result_out <- list(summary = summary_out, footprint = footprint)
jsonlite::fromJSON(jsonlite::toJSON(result_out, null = "null"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
```

```{.webgeods-r #viewshed-export-r}
#| inject: [obsLon, obsLat, obsHeight]
#| package: terra, jsonlite, codetools
# Recomputes the same viewshed (cheap relative to re-reading the
# source file) and writes it as an actual GeoTIFF via writeRaster() —
# in the CALCULATION crs (the projection the computation actually ran
# in), not the original file's CRS, since re-reprojecting the result
# back just for convenience would add a step with no real benefit —
# the download button below labels this explicitly.
library(terra)

r <- rast(path)
elevation <- r[[1]]

if (is.lonlat(elevation)) {
  e <- ext(elevation)
  center_lon <- (e$xmin + e$xmax) / 2
  center_lat <- (e$ymin + e$ymax) / 2
  utm_zone <- floor((center_lon + 180) / 6) + 1
  calc_epsg <- if (center_lat >= 0) 32600 + utm_zone else 32700 + utm_zone
  elevation_calc <- project(elevation, paste0("EPSG:", calc_epsg), method = "bilinear")
} else {
  elevation_calc <- elevation
}

obs_pt <- vect(matrix(c(as.numeric(obsLon), as.numeric(obsLat)), ncol = 2), crs = "EPSG:4326")
obs_pt_calc <- project(obs_pt, crs(elevation_calc))
obs_xy <- as.numeric(crds(obs_pt_calc)[1, ])

vs <- viewshed(elevation_calc, loc = obs_xy, observer = as.numeric(obsHeight), target = 0)

out_path <- "/tmp/viewshed.tif"
writeRaster(vs, out_path, overwrite = TRUE, filetype = "GTiff")
raw_bytes <- readBin(out_path, what = "raw", n = file.info(out_path)$size)
jsonlite::base64_enc(raw_bytes)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Colored overlay for a boolean result -- not a gradient like Band
// Math/NDVI. Both ramp stops are the same warm color: any finite
// value (only ever 1, "visible") paints solid, NaN ("not visible")
// stays transparent via _renderRasterCanvas's existing NaN handling.
VIEWSHED_RAMP = [
  [0.00, 255, 213, 79],
  [1.00, 255, 213, 79]
]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Static: unlike the band pickers on Calculator/NDVI, nothing here
// depends on the uploaded file's shape, so this cell (and the DOM
// nodes it creates) never needs to be rebuilt — map-click wiring
// below can bind to it once.
observerRow = {
  const row = document.createElement("div");
  row.className = "webgeods-panel-row";

  const makeNumberInput = (id, defaultValue, step, width) => {
    const input = document.createElement("input");
    input.type = "number";
    input.id = id;
    input.step = String(step);
    input.value = String(defaultValue);
    input.className = "webgeods-panel-status";
    input.style.width = width;
    return input;
  };

  const label = (text) => {
    const span = document.createElement("span");
    span.className = "webgeods-panel-status";
    span.textContent = text;
    return span;
  };

  const lonInput = makeNumberInput("observer-lon-input", 12.45, 0.0001, "95px");
  const latInput = makeNumberInput("observer-lat-input", 41.90, 0.0001, "95px");
  const heightInput = makeNumberInput("observer-height-input", 1.8, 0.1, "60px");

  const computeButton = document.createElement("button");
  computeButton.className = "webgeods-panel-btn";
  computeButton.textContent = "▶ Compute";
  computeButton.onclick = async () => {
    if (!inspectSummary) {
      mutable uploadStatus = "⚠️ Upload a DEM or load the example first.";
      return;
    }
    computeButton.disabled = true;
    const originalText = computeButton.textContent;
    computeButton.textContent = "⌛ Computing...";
    try {
      const obsLon = Number(lonInput.value);
      const obsLat = Number(latInput.value);
      const obsHeight = Number(heightInput.value);
      window.obsLon = obsLon;
      window.obsLat = obsLat;
      window.obsHeight = obsHeight;
      await window.WebGeoDS.CodeCell.find("viewshed-r").run();
      // The cell's own return value is { summary, footprint } (same
      // shape as the inspect cell, unlike Calculator/NDVI's flat
      // compute-cell output) -- summary holds the fields used here.
      const result = document.getElementById("viewshed-r").value.summary;
      await sharedMap.setRasterImage("viewshed-result", {
        bounds: result.wgs84Bounds,
        width: result.width,
        height: result.height,
        values: new Float32Array(base64ToBytes(result.data).buffer),
        min: 0,
        max: 1,
        colorRamp: VIEWSHED_RAMP
      });
      mutable resultSummary = { ...result, obsLon, obsLat };
      window.WebGeoDS.track?.("validation_completed", { tool: "viewshed-calculator" });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("viewshed-calculator: Compute failed", err);
      mutable uploadStatus = `⚠️ Compute failed: ${err.message}`;
    } finally {
      computeButton.disabled = false;
      computeButton.textContent = originalText;
    }
  };

  row.append(
    label("Observer lon:"), lonInput,
    label("lat:"), latInput,
    label("height (m):"), heightInput,
    label("— or click the map"),
    computeButton
  );

  return row;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Wires the map click -> observer inputs once. sharedMap.map is
// MapLibre's own instance (already used directly elsewhere in this
// session for source lookups) -- no new shared/map.js method needed,
// same "JS decides the interaction, the engine only computes"
// architecture as everywhere else on this site.
mapClickWiring = {
  sharedMap.map.on("click", (e) => {
    const lonInput = document.getElementById("observer-lon-input");
    const latInput = document.getElementById("observer-lat-input");
    if (lonInput) lonInput.value = e.lngLat.lng.toFixed(6);
    if (latInput) latInput.value = e.lngLat.lat.toFixed(6);
  });
  return true;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
downloadButton = {
  const button = document.createElement("button");
  button.className = "webgeods-panel-btn";
  button.dataset.variant = "outline";
  button.textContent = "⬇ Download (calculation CRS)";
  button.disabled = !resultSummary;
  button.onclick = async () => {
    if (!resultSummary) return;
    button.disabled = true;
    const originalText = button.textContent;
    button.textContent = "⌛ Preparing...";
    try {
      window.obsLon = resultSummary.obsLon;
      window.obsLat = resultSummary.obsLat;
      window.obsHeight = resultSummary.observerHeight;
      await window.WebGeoDS.CodeCell.find("viewshed-export-r").run();
      const b64 = document.getElementById("viewshed-export-r").value;
      const bytes = base64ToBytes(b64);
      const base = WebGeoDS.Upload.baseName(uploadedFiles);
      WebGeoDS.downloadBlob(
        bytes,
        base ? `${base}-viewshed.tif` : "viewshed.tif",
        "image/tiff",
        { tool: "viewshed-calculator" }
      );
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = originalText;
    }
  };
  return button;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
statCard = {
  const s = inspectSummary;
  const r = resultSummary;
  const box = document.createElement("div");
  box.className = "webgeods-stat-grid";

  const row = (label, value) => {
    const dt = document.createElement("div");
    dt.className = "webgeods-stat-label";
    dt.textContent = label;
    const dd = document.createElement("div");
    dd.className = "webgeods-stat-value";
    dd.textContent = value;
    box.append(dt, dd);
  };

  if (!s) {
    row("Dimensions", "—");
    row("—", "Upload a .tif/.tiff DEM or load the example above");
    return box;
  }

  row("Dimensions", `${s.width} × ${s.height} px`);
  row("Original CRS", s.crs === null || s.crs === undefined ? "Unknown ⚠️ viewshed needs a real-world location" : s.crs);
  row("Bounds", s.bounds.join(", "));

  if (r) {
    row("Calculation CRS", r.calculationCrs);
    row("Observer height", `${r.observerHeight} m`);
    row("Visible pixels", r.visiblePixels.toLocaleString());
    row("Total pixels", r.totalPixels.toLocaleString());
    row("Visible %", `${r.visiblePercent}%`);
  }

  return box;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
legendEl = {
  const r = resultSummary;
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.className = "webgeods-legend";
  if (!r) {
    wrap.hidden = true;
    return wrap;
  }
  const swatch = document.createElement("div");
  swatch.className = "webgeods-legend-bar";
  swatch.style.flex = "0 0 32px";
  swatch.style.background = "rgb(255,213,79)";
  const label = document.createElement("span");
  label.className = "webgeods-legend-label";
  label.textContent = "Visible from observer";
  wrap.append(swatch, label);
  return wrap;
}
```
